body.message:
Kindly note that the full payment must be completed prior to check-in. We can either provide you with a payment link; however, please be advised that a 3.1% card processing fee will apply.

Alternatively, you may proceed with a bank transfer. In this case, we recommend completing it in advance, as we will need to obtain confirmation from the finance team, which may take some time and could result in delays to your check-in. or you can visit the office to complete the payment by cash
